items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And Dick Noel of NBC's Breakfast Club, he recorded, this was about two years ago

ctx.x: He was active later, but I think his good band was in mid 20s. Yeah, in mid 20s.

And then I wrote, then I had three little girls and I said, well, maybe I said try to write something, make some money. So, well, in the 20, I think 1920 and 21 I wrote that 35th Street. And I had written Skizics. You know the little Skizics in front of the paper? Yes. Or the cuter song Skizic. I remember it too. And I took it downtown and they kept it for about a year. I forget the publisher. They kept it for about a year and did nothing with it. And then I wrote another, I wrote another little Foxtrot and I…
Well, sometimes, yeah, sometimes those things are slow starters. Yes. I mean, they're always for a period.
